name: github-control
description: Self-hosted dashboard to see, organize and keep healthy all your GitHub repositories

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w github-control-front" "npm run dev:back" --names "front,back" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:back
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd back && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build:server && cd back && node dist/server.mjs
